title: Le Comte de Monte-Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
why_this_book: One of the most celebrated French novels, extremely well-known to Kabyle speakers through French education. Rich narrative prose with diverse registers — action, dialogue, legal/formal language, intrigue. Tome I (of 2) is used here. An ideal benchmark for fra-kab translation quality given its cultural familiarity.
